releaseNotes: Stability sweep: fixes minSdk 24 API traps in picture-in-picture and QR token generation, gives Phone / QR setup a 5-minute expiring one-time pairing link, makes boot autostart fail closed if local state is corrupt, requires SHA-256 verified updates, narrows update FileProvider exposure to the updates folder, disables TV backup for credential/state safety, and clears TV lint errors. Mandatory because the updater is now less trusting, which is annoying but healthier.
